name: mcp-divoom-lan
description: MCP server for TimesFrame/AstroToo watchfaces, PIXOO64 and TimeGate 400/402 LAN control.
long_description: Discovers supported Divoom devices. TimesFrame/AstroToo use device Hardware queries; PIXOO64/TimeGate use discovery or explicit hardware profiles. Includes version-specific display control, TimeGate LocalToken and five-screen support. Hardware 96 and 402 command lists execute sequentially in MCP. Keeps AstroToo local-only assets and watchface read-before-write checks.

divoom_device_model.title: Product detection
divoom_device_model.description: auto, timesframe, astrotoo, pixoo64 or timegate. PIXOO64/TimeGate use discovery or explicit Hardware below.

divoom_device_hardware.title: Hardware profile (optional)
divoom_device_hardware.description: PIXOO64 90/92/96 or TimeGate 400/402 for the default device. Leave blank to use discovery.

timegate_local_token.title: TimeGate LocalToken (optional)
timegate_local_token.description: LocalToken from the default TimeGate device settings. Omit when supplying localToken in each tool call.

divoom_device_host.title: Default device IP (optional)
divoom_device_host.description: LAN IP address of the Divoom device (e.g. 192.168.1.120).

divoom_device_port.title: HTTP port
divoom_device_port.description: Optional port override. Leave blank for auto: PIXOO64 90/92 or TimeGate 400 uses 80, otherwise 9000.
